findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask, get_signals, get_quote, create_order, get_watch_feed, get_desk_feed · Private data: get_truth_object, ask, get_record, get_calibration, orient, propose_topic, get_quote, create_order, get_account, send_feedback · Public sink: ask, get_answer, propose_topic, create_order, send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask, get_signals, get_quote, create_order, get_watch_feed, get_desk_feed · Private data: get_truth_object, ask, get_record, get_calibration, orient, propose_topic, get_quote, create_order, get_account, send_feedback · Public sink: ask, get_answer, propose_topic, create_order, send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
